pre_grade_drift_check.placeholder_artwork_details: Drift gate clean. compose.py extension for the Fraction Street narrative is pending — deck routes to _drafts/ until added (independent of rubric quality).

pedagogical_depth.justification: Strict L4 met. All five lessons carry 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough blocks with paired misconceptions and recovery moves. Lesson 1 includes the zero-placeholder repair; Lesson 2 the cross-thousand comparison repair; Lesson 3 the wrong-place rounding repair; Lesson 4 the leftover-fraction calculation repair; Lesson 5 the additive equivalence misconception repair. Five distinct worksheet response_types. Mid-unit and end-of-unit assessments both present.

instructional_balance.justification: CRA progression spans the week: concrete (base-ten blocks with thousand-cubes, paper treats, fraction strips, equivalence pizzas) → representational (place-value mats, number-line jumps, tape diagrams) → abstract (numerical comparison, mixed numbers, equivalence equations). Lesson 5 is the fractions capstone integrating B1.7 with the multiplication pattern.

clarity_communication.justification: All five lessons have substantial teacher_script (≥3000 chars), 4-band expected_student_responses, and 3 paired misconceptions. Every lesson has 'I can' student_learning_goal. Teacher scripts use embodied gestures (place-value mat anchor, number-line jump, fair-share dealing, fraction-strip stacking).

alignment.justification: consistency_check 0 issues; verify_curriculum_text 0 issues; validate_unit_alignment 0 issues. Every B1.1-B1.7 code is cited as a primary expectation in at least one lesson; assessment_suite.summative_rubric covers all 7 codes. classroom_time_total_minutes (250) equals 5 × 50.
